golden_harvest: A radiant sheaf of golden wheat raised high by a farmer's hands, grains bursting into light like sparks, a village of happy families and a brimming harvest basket below.
rain_of_plenty: Glowing blue rain falling from a single luminous cloud over a whole valley of small villages, every field sprouting green, silver droplets turning into tiny stars.
pioneers_charter: A family of pioneers with a laden ox-cart setting out along a sunlit road toward unexplored hills, a golden compass glowing in the sky ahead pointing the way, a sealed wax-stamped blank parchment in the lead pioneer's hand.
royal_survey: A royal surveyor planting a banner pole on a hilltop while glowing golden border lines spread across the valley below like threads of light, a brass theodolite beside him.
guild_overtime: Guild craftsmen hammering in a blazing workshop at night, sparks fountaining upward, giant bronze gears turning behind them, a great hourglass with glowing sand racing.
master_builders: A grand stone tower rising instantly out of scaffolding in a burst of golden light, masons with raised mallets cheering, stone blocks flying into place by themselves.
miracle_of_masons: A colossal golden pyramid assembling itself in a single luminous moment, gigantic stone blocks floating upward on beams of light, tiny masons kneeling in awe at its base.
terraform: A giant hand of light reshaping the land, a forest peeling away and the earth folding upward into green hills, a mountain spirit rising from the ground.
verdant_rain: Emerald rain sweeping over a desert, dunes turning into lush grassland as it passes, flowers and trees bursting from the sand in a spreading wave of green.
imperial_roads: A great paved stone road unrolling itself across hills toward the horizon, milestones and arches, a galloping courier on horseback, sunrise at the end of the road.
levy: Two fresh soldiers with round shields and spears stepping forward in unison out of a glowing city gate, banners unfurling above them, drum and horn raised.
conscription: Rows of townsfolk handing over their tools and taking up swords before a war banner, a stern officer with a raised sword leading the column out of the city.
sanctuary: A wounded warrior kneeling in prayer within a shaft of healing light inside a stone temple, his shield glowing as a protective dome of light surrounds him.
balm_of_ages: A golden chalice pouring glowing healing elixir that flows like a river of light over a battlefield, wounded soldiers and cracked city walls mending as it passes.
forge_of_heroes: A hero's old bronze sword plunged into a blazing magical anvil and emerging as gleaming steel, an armoured smith striking it with a glowing hammer, sparks everywhere.
veterans_laurels: A battle-scarred veteran soldier being crowned with a glowing golden laurel wreath by a general, his armour gleaming, comrades saluting behind.
olive_branch: A white dove carrying a glowing olive branch between two opposing armies, soldiers lowering their spears, the sun breaking through storm clouds between them.
revelation: A scholar in a dark study struck by a pillar of light from above, a glowing all-seeing eye opening in the sky, orbiting diagrams of light forming around the scholar.
scholars_boon: A wise white owl spreading luminous wings over a scholar's desk, glowing blank pages flying up like birds, candlelit books and an astrolabe.
rediscovery: An explorer brushing sand from an ancient buried vault, a glowing forgotten scroll case revealed inside, beams of light spilling out into the ruins.
cartographers_commission: A tall ship sailing off the edge of a painted sea toward unknown lands, fog parting before its bow to reveal glowing coastlines, a brass compass rose shining in the sky.
spymasters_ledger: A hooded spymaster in a candlelit room turning an ornate golden key in a lock, shadows of distant rival castles projected on the wall through a keyhole of light.
windfall: A torrent of gold coins pouring down from the sky into a treasury chest, a delighted merchant catching them in his hat, golden light everywhere.
tribute: Foreign envoys kneeling before a throne presenting chests overflowing with gold and jewels, a crown gleaming on a velvet cushion, golden light on marble steps.
hermits_tithe: An old hermit in a mountain cave turning a great hourglass whose sand is glowing violet crystals, the crystals multiplying as they fall into an overflowing bowl.
royal_audit: A royal auditor with brass spectacles weighing golden emblem medallions on grand scales in a vaulted treasury, a heavy iron key hanging at his belt.
grand_festival: A grand festival night in a city square, masked dancers whirling, fireworks bursting in magenta and gold, lanterns strung between towers, a jubilant crowd.
epiphany: A young thinker gazing upward as a brilliant violet-white star of inspiration bursts open above her head, rays of light pouring down and a golden lyre resonating on its own beside her, night sky over a marble terrace.
codex_universalis: A colossal glowing tome opening in the sky above a city, its blank pages radiating six beams of coloured light down onto the land, scholars looking up in awe.
heavens_clemency: A golden sun breaking through a black storm, a single shaft of divine light falling on a kneeling crowned ruler, a broken crown on the ground being restored to wholeness.
augurs_sign: An augur with raised arms reading the flight of a great serpent-shaped flock of birds across a golden sky, a sacred altar smoking beside her.
patronage: A noble patron's jewelled hand offering a glowing sealed commission to a kneeling young artist, a gallery of half-finished statues and paintings behind them.
gilded_charter: A plain bronze emblem medallion being dipped into a basin of liquid gold by a jeweller's tongs, emerging gilded and glowing, a laurel of gold leaf flying off it.
fortunes_wheel: A great ornate wheel of fortune spinning in the night sky, its spokes studded with stars and gems of gold, ruby and prismatic crystal, sparks flying from its rim.
mirror_of_ages: An ornate silver hand-mirror under a crescent moon reflecting a glowing jewel into a second identical glowing jewel, starlight rippling across the mirror surface.
veil_of_ether: A translucent ethereal veil woven of starlight drifting away from an ornate emblem, the emblem turning ghostly and weightless, a single luminous feather floating beside it.
